list.title: Runs
list.description: Every agent run, with its steps, tools and cost.
list.empty: No runs yet. They show up when you talk to an agent or a task or schedule starts. <link>Open chat</link>
list.emptyFiltered: No runs match these filters. <link>Reset filters</link>

actions.cancelDescription: The run stops now and does not continue. This cannot be undone.

errors.onlyFailedRerun: Only failed runs can be run again
errors.noConversation: This run has no conversation to continue
errors.agentDeleted: The agent of this run was deleted

input.title: Input
input.noPrompt: continues the conversation, no new prompt
input.fromConversation: The run started from the existing conversation (a chat message or a continuation after an approval).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.emptyActive: Steps show up here as the agent works.
timeline.emptyDone: The run recorded no steps, fallbacks or errors.

links.none: This run is not linked to a task or conversation.

timeline.emptyStep: Step with no text or tools.
timeline.fallbackExhausted: {from} failed and there is no other model in the chain
timeline.fallbackRetried: {kind}, retried {retries, plural, one {once} other {# times}} over {seconds} s
timeline.retry: {kind}: {model} is called again in {seconds} s (retry {attempt} of {max})
timeline.loopNudge: The agent repeated the same calls to {tools} over {steps} steps and was told to change approach:
timeline.compaction: A prompt of about {before} tokens became {after}, summarized by {model} for {cost}

compactionReason.soft: The prompt passed 60% of the context window after its cache expired.
compactionReason.hard: The prompt passed 90% of the context window.
compactionReason.overflow: The model rejected the prompt as too long.

timeline.compactionFlushed: {count, plural, one {# fact saved to memory.} other {# facts saved to memory.}}
timeline.steered: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} sent while the agent worked reached it after step {step}.

lifecycle.unqueued: The run never started: its job is no longer in the queue
lifecycle.overdue: The run went past its time limit and was stopped
lifecycle.stoppedAtLimit: The run stopped at a limit before the work was finished: {reason}. The task is not complete: what was done so far is kept, and the rest still has to be done.
lifecycle.toolInterrupted: Interrupted: the worker stopped while this tool was running. It may or may not have taken effect; check before repeating it.

kill_switch.label: Kill switch
kill_switch.hint: The kill switch stopped it. Turn the kill switch off to run agents again.

agent_disabled.label: Agent disabled
agent_disabled.hint: Enable the agent in its settings, then run it again.

budget.label: Budget reached
budget.hint: Raise the budget (the agent's limits, the project, or Settings > Budget), or wait for next month.

no_model.label: No model
no_model.hint: Pick a model for the agent, or set the default model in Settings > Models.

provider_not_allowed.label: Provider not allowed
provider_not_allowed.hint: The project restricts its AI providers. Give the agent a model from an allowed provider, or change the project's restriction.

no_conversation.label: No conversation
no_conversation.hint: The run's conversation was deleted. Start the task or the chat again.

provider_auth.label: Provider rejected the key
provider_auth.hint: Check the API key or the connection in Settings > Models.

rate_limited.label: Rate limited
rate_limited.hint: The provider is limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes, or add another provider to the agent's models.

usage_limit.label: Usage limit reached
usage_limit.hint: The plan's usage limit or the account's credit ran out. Wait for it to reset, add credit, or use another provider.

providers_unavailable.label: Providers unavailable
providers_unavailable.hint: No model of the agent answered. Check the providers in Settings > Models and the agent's models, then try again.

context_overflow.label: Context full
context_overflow.hint: The conversation no longer fits in the model's context window. Its next run summarizes the earlier messages first; you can also start a new conversation or use a model with a larger context.

timeout.label: Time limit
timeout.hint: Raise the agent's time limit, or split the work into smaller tasks.

step_limit.label: Step limit
step_limit.hint: The agent was still working when it used up its steps. Raise its step limit, or split the work into smaller tasks.

loop.label: Loop
loop.hint: The agent kept repeating the same calls. The timeline shows which; make the task clearer, then run it again.

worker_restarted.label: Worker restarted
worker_restarted.hint: The worker restarted during the run. Check what was already done, then run it again.

unqueued.label: Never started
unqueued.hint: The run's job was lost from the queue. Run it again.

overdue.label: Stuck past its time limit
overdue.hint: The run stopped responding past its time limit. Check the worker's logs, then run it again.

cancelled_by_user.label: Cancelled by you
cancelled_by_user.hint: Run it again when you want it to continue.

other.label: Error
other.hint: The error above and the timeline say what went wrong.
